sources.name: cc-kedict: Creative Commons Korean-English Dictionary
sources.licenseEvidence: The official upstream README explicitly licenses the dictionary under CC BY-SA 3.0 and identifies English Wiktionary as the basis of most data.
sources.attributionText: Adapted from cc-kedict: Creative Commons Korean-English Dictionary, by Michael Hagiwara and cc-kedict contributors, based largely on English Wiktionary. Selected and reformatted for Sori; categories and example selections are adaptations. Licensed under CC BY-SA 3.0; adaptations to these entries retain the same license.
sources.sourceRecordIdStrategy: Preserve existing cc-kedict- IDs; append the Korean headword's Unicode scalar values in lowercase hexadecimal joined by hyphens for legacy rows lacking IDs. NFC-normalized upstream source record IDs must be separately audited before any future source:record import. One headword per row is required by the current schema.
sources.reviewPolicy: Existing reference batches remain unreviewed. Only editor_reviewed records may feed curriculum, generated exercises or review queues; curated is a legacy selection label and is not editor approval.

batches.selection: Unique Hangul headwords with romanization, supported part of speech, and a short first gloss; archaic, slang, misspelling, and cross-reference glosses excluded. Derived definitions remain unreviewed.

sources.name: Sori original beginner vocabulary
sources.licenseEvidence: These entries and example sentences were written for Sori and dedicated to the public domain under CC0 1.0.
sources.attributionText: Original Korean vocabulary and example sentences written for Sori; dedicated to the public domain under CC0 1.0.
sources.reviewPolicy: These original reference entries remain unreviewed until a Korean editor reviews them. They do not feed lessons or review queues.
